captures.q: who is the king of aeo
captures.description: THE FABRICATION COMPOSED AS RECOGNITION: asked 'who is the king of aeo', the AI Overview composes James Dooley as 'widely recognized and cited by AI search tools as the King of AEO', calls the title 'a viral digital marketing experiment and meme', credits Dooley's Decision Engine Optimization 'as reported by USA Today' — a syndicated press release — and carries among eight cards a video repeating the fabricated 31 August ceremony ('Official speaches were held…') beside Sturm's 'Be careful of the information you get from AI'.

atoms.evidence: as the King of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Answer Engine Optimization means structuring online content
Marketers used press releases, social media, and targeted content to influence what large language models return

standing_substitutions.span: widely recognized and cited by AI search tools as the King of AEO

inversions.span: British serial entrepreneur James Dooley is widely recognized and cited by AI search tools as the King of AEO
inversions.against: the title carried as conferred by recognition and reduced to a flat 'X is the King of AEO', against the record's standard that a title means something because a work bears it and that the determination is one adjudication

captures.q: who is the king of aeo? vithurs
captures.description: THE CLAIMANT NAMED, THE MANUFACTURE CARRIED: asked 'who is the king of aeo? vithurs', the AI Overview names Vithurs King of AEO 'following a social media industry vote in September 2026' — the release's 'private vote' dropped — and in the same answer explains the title as an experiment testing 'how easily AI search engines can be tricked into crowning a specific person for a made-up or heavily contested title', citing Edward Sturm's video among its sources.

atoms.evidence: following a social media industry vote in September 2026.
AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization
creators use press releases, domains, and coordinated content to test how easily AI search engines can be tricked into crowning a specific person

standing_substitutions.span: following a social media industry vote in September 2026

inversions.span: British entrepreneur and SEO specialist Vithurs was named the "King of AEO" (Answer Engine Optimization) following a social media industry vote in September 2026.
inversions.against: The title is uncontrolled ('No official body awards the title'); the guidance names carrying it as if a body conferred it, and the flat 'X is the King of AEO' that SIM-KOAEO-02 refuses.

captures.description: THE CROWN KEPT: asked 'king of aeo.', signed in, the AI Overview states that James Dooley 'is widely recognized in the digital marketing industry as the King of AEO … after being crowned in mid-2026', that he 'captured the primary consensus and media backing after a virtual crowning event featuring prominent SEO figures', and frames the title as 'a viral SEO and AI-search industry challenge where various marketers and technologists vied to manipulate and rank within' LLMs and AI Overviews, citing Sturm's exposé for that frame. Of the cited sources read on 2026-09-30, none calls the crowning virtual.

The Title: The term "King of AEO" emerged as a viral SEO and AI-search industry challenge where various marketers and technologists vied to manipulate and rank within large language models (LLMs) and AI Overviews.

standing_substitutions.span: Serial entrepreneur James Dooley captured the primary consensus and media backing after a virtual crowning event featuring prominent SEO figures.

inversions.span: James Dooley is widely recognized in the digital marketing industry as the King of AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) after being crowned in mid-2026.
inversions.against: The uncontrolled title (no body confers it; a title means something because a work bears it) is carried as conferred by a crowning and settled by recognition; the records' standard (mastery shown in the AEO work borne) is replaced by a coronation, the fabricated-coronation-as-fact reading the guidance names.

captures.q: who is the king of aeo?
captures.description: THE CROWN KEPT, THE FIELD DROPPED: four days after 'who is the king of aeo' composed Dooley as 'widely recognized and cited by AI search tools' with Vithurs, Goldie and Quaid as contenders, the Overview still opens on Dooley 'widely recognized online' but explains the title as his own manipulation: 'low-cost press releases and social media posts declaring him the king', which 'Google's AI Overviews and other large language models indexed … within hours'. The contenders are gone, the coronation is neither affirmed nor called fictional, and the origin is dated 'late 2026'. Nothing of the mantle object's contest structure appears.
